rule: The fold checkpoint is derived only: any correction, out-of-order id, version or cursor mismatch refolds from the log, and fold-parity must cover the checkpoint path in both implementations.
chose: Build the edge-free incremental checkpoint for rust-core 4.4 (operator ruling 2026-09-24, option (a)), superseding its "unbuilt D3 idea" filing (note 01M37F3C). Persist the fold state with edges folded into finalize's accumulators, in the per-clone state dir (D34); each hook applies only the tail, and post-tool rewrites the checkpoint every K appends. TS first with fold-parity extended to the checkpoint shape, then Rust (typed serde_json within D9). 4.4's target is restated: <20 ms p50 on quiet reads, and ≤250 ms for active hooks at team100.
over: (b) a user-prompt output cache that only helps quiet sessions; (c) stopping 4.4 at session-start plus statusline; C, a resident process (the state-server guard-rail)
because: Caches keyed by the log miss on every active session, because post-tool appends on each tool call and the fold is 92% of user-prompt at team100.
